recipes.title: 5-Minute Mortadella Breakfast Sandwich
steps: Whisk the eggs, mayo and salt until smooth.
Pour into a lightly greased microwave-safe bowl and microwave 45–60 seconds until just set (José Andrés' trick).
Meanwhile sear the mortadella in a non-stick pan over medium-high for 1 minute, flip, top with the cheese and cook 1 minute more.
Toast the cut bun in the mortadella fat for 30–45 seconds.
Stack the bun, cheesy mortadella and the egg 'omelette', then top.
recipes.notes: Amounts are as said in the video; the mortadella count is an estimate and the macros are estimates (not a light recipe).
